# Dilemma v3.5.0

Players can reopen their saved quiz answer in a private panel, select an answer with a green button and check their individual result after closing. Shared quiz buttons keep the same appearance for everyone.

- Open My answer to see the saved choice, change or withdraw it, and refresh the panel. Green marks the saved choice, not whether the answer is correct.
- Use 50/50 to keep only two answer buttons in the private panel. The hint does not automatically change an existing vote. Buying it costs 5 Sparks once per quiz; reopening is free. Vote changes and withdrawal still cost 1 Spark.
- Open My result on a closed quiz or its result message to see the final choice, correct answer, awarded points and bet settlement. Bet results separate the stake, total payout and profit or loss. A winning 10-Spark bet pays 20 Sparks in total, for a bet profit of 10 Sparks.
- Keep profile rank and Sparks frames compact and sized to the displayed value. End the card at its lavender frame and use subtle navy, lavender and gold decorations matching quiz cards. Preserve large values, long names, zero balances and rounded corners.
- Verify private interactions, fees, free hint reopening, payout reporting and stale controls with isolated PostgreSQL tests.

No database migration or Discord command registration is required when upgrading from v3.4.1. Existing active quiz messages can open the private panel after an answer or 50/50 action; newly published quizzes also include My answer.
